content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: (XQL(MP-001 NGFW Repetitive HTTP Beacon To testmynids) AND (BIOC(MP-001 Curl Beacon With Suspicious User-Agent From www-data) OR BIOC(MP-001 Interactive Shell Spawned From www-data Service Context))) -> join on src_host within 60s
rules.name: C2 Beacon Cross-Plane Stitch — NGFW Session + XDR Process

rules.logic: (XQL(MP-001 NGFW DNS TXT High Entropy Burst) AND XQL(MP-001 Repetitive Dig TXT From Service Account)) -> join on src_host within 60s
rules.name: DNS Tunnel Exfil Cross-Plane Stitch — NGFW DNS Anomaly + XDR Dig Loop

rules.logic: (XQL(MP-001 NGFW Download From IOC Listed Domain) AND BIOC(MP-001 Curl Wrote Second-Stage File To Tmp From Service Account) AND IOC(domain: testmynids.org)) -> join on src_host within 60s
rules.name: Ingress Transfer IOC Stitch — NGFW Download + XDR Tmp Write + TIM IOC
